sentences.zh: Unlike in past investigations where the White House has successfully shut down Congress, important witnesses are coming, and they're going to talk, and they're going to tell their

sentences.en: So another busy day.
sentences.zh: 又是忙碌的一天。

sentences.en: Where is your head as Wednesday comes to an end?
sentences.zh: 周三快结束时，你有什么想法？

sentences.en: So by the end of Wednesday, it just feels, you know, inescapable that this is all building, at least this week, towards Gordon Sondland coming in himself on Thursday and giving his
sentences.zh: 所以到了周三结束时，感觉就像是，你知道，不可避免地，这一切——至少在本周——都在为戈登·桑德兰周四亲自出席并给出他的

sentences.en: account of what happened, facing questions about these various kind of accusations and accounts
sentences.zh: 陈述做铺垫，他要面对关于各种指控和说法的质询，

sentences.en: that investigators have been getting all week and figuring out, you know, how does he explain this stuff?
sentences.zh: 这些指控和说法是调查人员整周都在收集的，他们也在琢磨，你知道，他该如何解释这些事情？

sentences.en: How does he view what was going on?
sentences.zh: 他如何看待当时发生的一切？

sentences.en: And, you know, we left the Capitol Wednesday evening waiting to see exactly what he was going to say.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们周三晚上离开国会大厦时，还在等着看他到底会说什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Like, if this is a play, the character that everyone's been talking about for the last
sentences.zh: 就像如果这是一出戏，每个人过去90分钟里一直在谈论的角色，

sentences.en: 90 minutes eventually has to come on stage and say something.
sentences.zh: 最终必须走上舞台说点什么。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Except for in this case, the stage is behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 只不过在这个案例中，舞台是在闭门会议室里。

sentences.en: And saying something, it turns out, amounts to releasing an 18-page opening statement Thursday morning right before he begins to answer questions.
sentences.zh: 而所谓“说点什么”，结果竟然是在周四早上，就在他开始回答问题之前，发布了一份18页的开场陈述。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Welcome.
sentences.zh: 欢迎。

sentences.en: Very nice to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Very nice to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: So that's how Thursday morning begins.
sentences.zh: 这就是周四早上的开始方式。

sentences.en: What happened to our gig?
sentences.zh: 我们的演出怎么了？

sentences.en: I walk into the Capitol with Rachel and Claire, just as it seems you are digesting Gordon Sondland's opening statement.
sentences.zh: 我和瑞秋、克莱尔走进国会大厦时，看起来你们正好在消化戈登·桑德兰的开场陈述。

sentences.en: So my morning was basically spent trying to go through 18 pages of what he was going to go in there and say, right.
sentences.zh: 所以我基本上花了一上午的时间试图通读他准备进去说的这18页内容，没错。

sentences.en: We received a copy of his opening statement and Mike Schmidt, our colleague and I, poured through it to try and figure out what's new here?
sentences.zh: 我们收到了他开场陈述的副本，我和我的同事迈克·施密特仔细研读，试图找出这里面有什么新东西？

sentences.en: What's he addressing?
sentences.zh: 他在回应什么？

sentences.en: What does he have to say?
sentences.zh: 他要说些什么？

sentences.en: And a couple of things jumped out at us.
sentences.zh: 有几点引起了我们的注意。

sentences.en: He basically says in a meeting that he had with President Trump in May, not long after the new Ukrainian president is elected, President Trump basically rejected Sondland's advice
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，在五月份他与特朗普总统的一次会面中，就在新任乌克兰总统当选后不久，特朗普总统基本上拒绝了桑德兰的建议，

sentences.en: and the advice of other diplomats that were with him who said, you know, Mr. President, we think you ought to meet with this new guy.
sentences.zh: 也拒绝了与他同行的其他外交官的建议，他们当时说，总统先生，我们认为你应该见见这位新人。

sentences.en: We think he's going to do good work.
sentences.zh: 我们认为他会做出一番成绩。

sentences.en: Trump didn't seem interested and then directed them, Sondland said, to go through Rudy
sentences.zh: 特朗普似乎不感兴趣，然后指示他们——桑德兰说——去找鲁迪·朱利安尼，

sentences.en: Giuliani, to go through his private lawyer.
sentences.zh: 去找他的私人律师。

sentences.en: On Ukraine foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 处理乌克兰外交政策。

sentences.en: He gave Sondland, his ambassador to the European Union and other high-ranking officials in
sentences.zh: 他给了桑德兰（他的欧盟大使）以及房间里的其他高级官员一个直接的印象，

sentences.en: the room, the direct impression that he had empowered Rudy Giuliani to basically run American policy toward Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 那就是他已经授权鲁迪·朱利安尼基本上来主导美国对乌克兰的政策。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I mean, all week we'd been hearing these career nonpartisan diplomats coming in and pointing at Gordon Sondland.
sentences.zh: 我是说，整整一周我们都在听这些职业的、无党派的外交官进来指证戈登·桑德兰。

sentences.en: And here you have Gordon Sondland turning around just as quickly and pointing at the president and Rudy Giuliani and saying, everything I did, I did because they told me to.
sentences.zh: 而现在，戈登·桑德兰转过身来，同样迅速地指向总统和鲁迪·朱利安尼，说我所做的一切，都是因为他们让我这么做的。

sentences.en: And I didn't always feel good about it.
sentences.zh: 而且我并不总是觉得这样做很好。

sentences.en: I don't think Rudy Giuliani should have been involved.
sentences.zh: 我不认为鲁迪·朱利安尼应该参与其中。

sentences.en: I think the men and women of the State Department ought to be running our foreign policy, he testified.
sentences.zh: 他作证说，我认为国务院的男男女女才应该负责我们的外交政策。

sentences.en: But I have to follow the directions of the president.
sentences.zh: 但我必须遵循总统的指示。

sentences.en: And I thought more or less that I could work within those parameters to still achieve an end that I believed in, to still help Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我当时认为，多多少少我可以在这些参数范围内工作，以实现我所相信的目标，继续帮助乌克兰。

sentences.en: And he says something interesting.
sentences.zh: 而且他说了一件有趣的事。

sentences.en: He says, I didn't realize at first, it was only later that I realized that Rudy Giuliani may have had some other motivations in mind.
sentences.zh: 他说，我起初没有意识到，直到后来我才意识到鲁迪·朱利安尼可能还有其他动机。

sentences.en: As if all of this is not enough, one of the president's loyal diplomats seeming to turn on him and point the finger back at him.
sentences.zh: 仿佛这一切还不够，总统的一位忠诚外交官似乎反戈一击，把矛头指向了他。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Mr. Scheer.
sentences.zh: 希尔先生。

sentences.en: Good to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: My colleague Mike Scheer walks up.
sentences.zh: 我的同事迈克·希尔走过来。

sentences.en: I'm just going to say any email that starts with this will be interesting.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，任何以这个开头的邮件都会很有趣。

sentences.en: I want to read the rest of.
sentences.zh: 我想读剩下的部分。

sentences.en: Oh, geez.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: And says, hey, the White House chief of staff, Mick Mulvaney, who never addresses the press, has just scheduled the 1230 press conference at the White House.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，白宫办公厅主任米克·马尔瓦尼，那个从不面对媒体的人，刚刚在白宫安排了12点30分的记者会。

sentences.en: He's going to talk to reporters.
sentences.zh: 他要和记者谈谈。

sentences.en: And we think he's going to talk about Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我们认为他会谈论乌克兰问题。

sentences.en: But, I mean, he should get a lot of questions about this stuff, about impeachment.
sentences.zh: 但是，我是说，他应该会收到很多关于这些事情、关于弹劾的问题。

sentences.en: He takes questions.
sentences.zh: 他接受了提问。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, he's going to the White House press briefing room.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，他要去白宫新闻发布室。

sentences.en: So, Mike and I go back to a press room just outside the SCIF and set up shop around his computer where we tune into this press conference.
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克和我回到SCIF（敏感隔离信息设施）外面的新闻室，在他的电脑旁安顿下来，收听这场记者会。

sentences.en: What's happening?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: We're with Nick Vandos and Mike Scheer watching Mulvaney.
sentences.zh: 我们和尼克·范多斯以及迈克·希尔一起看着马尔瓦尼。

sentences.en: He starts to field questions, and it gets crazy really faSt.
sentences.zh: 他开始回答问题，事情变得非常快，非常疯狂。

sentences.en: Did he also mention to me in the past the corruption related to the DNC server?
sentences.zh: 他过去有没有向我提到过与民主党全国委员会服务器相关的腐败问题？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对有。

sentences.en: No question about that.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: But that's it.
sentences.zh: 但就是这样。

sentences.en: And that's why we held up the money.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们扣留资金的原因。

sentences.en: Now, there was a report.
sentences.zh: 现在，有一份报告。

sentences.en: After this week of kind of slow drip disclosures and after weeks of the White House denying that
sentences.zh: 在经历了这一周缓慢的披露，以及白宫数周以来一直否认

sentences.en: there had been any kind of leverage or quid pro quo or exchange with the Ukrainians around the
sentences.zh: 在乌克兰安全援助暂停问题上存在任何形式的杠杆、利益交换或交易之后，他站出来，基本上说——他确实在记录中说——

sentences.en: suspension of security aid for the country, he comes out and basically says, he does say on the record, that...
sentences.zh: 那个……

sentences.en: So the demand for an investigation into the Democrats was part of the reason that he wanted to withhold funding to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 所以，要求对民主党人进行调查是他想要扣留对乌克兰资金的部分原因。

sentences.en: The look back to what happened in 2016 certainly was part of the thing that he was worried about in corruption with that nation.
sentences.zh: 回顾2016年发生的事情，当然是他担心的那个国家腐败问题的一部分。

sentences.en: And that is absolutely appropriate.
sentences.zh: 这是绝对恰当的。

sentences.en: The White House withheld the aid for several reasons, and one of those reasons was President
sentences.zh: 白宫出于几个原因扣留了援助，其中一个原因是特朗普总统

sentences.en: Trump wanted Ukraine to first commit to investigating potential collusion between Ukrainians and Democrats in the 2016 election that was meant to undermine his campaign.
sentences.zh: 希望乌克兰首先承诺调查2016年大选中乌克兰人和民主党人之间潜在的勾结，这些勾结旨在破坏他的竞选活动。

sentences.en: And on top of it, Mulvaney says, yep, this was the deal.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，马尔瓦尼说，是的，这就是交易。

sentences.en: But to be clear, what you just described is a quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 但要明确一点，你刚才描述的就是利益交换（quid pro quo）。

sentences.en: Reporters quickly call that a quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 记者们很快称之为利益交换。

sentences.en: It is, funding will not flow unless the investigation into the Democratic server happened as well.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，除非对民主党服务器的调查也进行，否则资金就不会发放。

sentences.en: We do that all the time with foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 我们在外交政策上一直这样做。

sentences.en: And he said, that's fine, it happens all the time, there's nothing wrong with it.
sentences.zh: 他说，这没问题，这经常发生，没什么不对的。

sentences.en: If you read the news reports and you believe them, what did McKinney say yesterday?
sentences.zh: 如果你读了新闻报道并且相信它们，麦金利昨天说了什么？

sentences.en: Well, McKinney said yesterday that he was really upset with the political influence in foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，麦金利昨天说，他对外交政策中的政治影响感到非常不安。

sentences.en: That was one of the reasons he was so upset about this.
sentences.zh: 这就是他对此感到如此不安的原因之一。

sentences.en: And I have news for everybody.
sentences.zh: 我有个消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Get over it.
sentences.zh: 克服它吧。

sentences.en: There's going to be political influence in foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 外交政策中会有政治影响。

sentences.en: I mean, that's an extraordinary thing for the White House chief of staff to say.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这对白宫办公厅主任来说是一个非同寻常的说法。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: And he goes a little bit further.
sentences.zh: 而且他更进一步。

sentences.en: He's asked about Rudy Giuliani and his role.
sentences.zh: 有人问他关于鲁迪·朱利安尼及其角色的问题。

sentences.en: And his defense, again, is essentially that the president of the United States gets to dictate foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 他的辩护再次本质上是说，美国总统有权决定外交政策。

sentences.en: And if he wants his personal lawyer, a guy who he's not paying, a guy who's doing business, by the way, in Ukraine,
sentences.zh: 如果他想让他的私人律师——一个他没付钱的人，一个顺便在乌克兰做生意的人，

sentences.en: at the same time he's evidently doing diplomacy, to run American foreign policy, well, that's his prerogative.
sentences.zh: 同时显然在进行外交活动——来主导美国外交政策，嗯，那是他的特权。

sentences.en: Elections have consequences.
sentences.zh: 选举是有后果的。

sentences.en: And that's OK.
sentences.zh: 这没关系。

sentences.en: There's nothing wrong with it.
sentences.zh: 没什么不对的。

sentences.en: Elections do have consequences, and they should.
sentences.zh: 选举确实有后果，而且理应如此。

sentences.en: And your foreign policy is going to change.
sentences.zh: 你的外交政策将会改变。

sentences.en: Obama did it in one way.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马以一种方式做到了。

sentences.en: We're doing it a different way.
sentences.zh: 我们正在以另一种方式做。

sentences.en: And there's no problem with that.
sentences.zh: 这没什么问题。

sentences.en: It's a pretty stunning assertion, a pretty stunning view of executive power.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当令人震惊的断言，一种相当令人震惊的行政权力观。

sentences.en: It suggests the White House has not been telling the whole truth up till today.
sentences.zh: 这表明白宫直到今天都没有说出全部真相。

sentences.en: And then decided to tell it in a kind of extreme, unexpected way.
sentences.zh: 然后决定以一种极端、意想不到的方式说出来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's a little baffling to understand what exactly Mick Mulvaney was doing here.
sentences.zh: 很难理解米克·马尔瓦尼到底在做什么。

sentences.en: It's nice to see everybody.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到大家。

sentences.en: Thanks again.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So we should get on the phone.
sentences.zh: 所以我们应该打个电话。

sentences.en: There's also probably about to be a House vote where we may need to go and get some, see if we can't get some quick reaction.
sentences.zh: 众议院可能也要进行投票，我们可能需要去看看能不能得到一些快速反应。

sentences.en: You know, it was pretty evident in the hour or so after that press conference that lawmakers on Capitol Hill didn't quite know what to make of it either.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在那场新闻发布会后的一小时左右，国会山的议员们显然也不知道该怎么看待这件事。

sentences.en: Today, the chief of staff said what we've always suspected, that it was also about exonerating Russia and looking at the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 今天，办公厅主任说了我们一直怀疑的事情，即这也关乎为俄罗斯开脱，并审视2016年大选。

sentences.en: But some said, well, they just admitted to the whole thing, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 但有些人说，好吧，我想他们刚刚承认了整件事。

sentences.en: So what do we do now?
sentences.zh: 那我们现在该怎么办？

sentences.en: Others, Adam Schiff said.
sentences.zh: 其他人，亚当·希夫说。

sentences.en: Certainly indicates that things have gone from very, very bad to much, much worse.
sentences.zh: 这无疑表明事情已经从非常非常糟糕变得更加糟糕了。

sentences.en: A story that's very, very bad just got much, much worse.
sentences.zh: 一个非常非常糟糕的故事刚刚变得更加糟糕了。

sentences.en: Well, to the extent, Nick, that it's knowable, what do you make of why the White House decided to do this?
sentences.zh: 那么，尼克，在可知的范围内，你认为白宫为什么决定这样做？

sentences.en: It's kind of hard to understand.
sentences.zh: 这有点难以理解。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: We don't know if Mulvaney was acting on his own authority, who had put him out there.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道马尔瓦尼是否是自行其是，是谁把他推到台前的。

sentences.en: The president's legal team, one of his other lawyers, who's not Rudy Giuliani, said he hadn't been consulted before Mulvaney went out there.
sentences.zh: 总统的法律团队，他的另一位律师（不是鲁迪·朱利安尼），说他在马尔瓦尼出去之前没有被咨询过。

sentences.en: You know, there has been a move that President Trump returns to time and again in his presidency.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特朗普总统在任期内反复采取过一种策略。

sentences.en: And part of me wonders if this isn't the same thing, where when he's being accused of something bad,
sentences.zh: 我有时会想，这难道不是同一回事吗？当他被指控做了什么坏事时，

sentences.en: of having done something under the table or that would be deemed inappropriate for others.
sentences.zh: 做了什么见不得人的事，或者被认为对他人不恰当的事。

sentences.en: Instead of pretending he didn't, he just kind of throws it all out into the open and says, you know, yeah, I did this, but I don't think there's anything wrong with it.
sentences.zh: 他没有假装没做，而是直接把它摊开，说，你知道，是的，我做了，但我认为这没什么不对的。

sentences.en: So what?
sentences.zh: 那又怎样？

sentences.en: Tell me it's wrong.
sentences.zh: 告诉我它哪里错了。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, at the end of this week, one of the biggest questions that I think emerges from all this stuff is that it's now up to Congress, not just Democrats,
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，在本周结束时，我认为从所有这些事情中出现的最大问题之一是，现在取决于国会，不仅仅是民主党人，

sentences.en: but Republicans too, to answer that question and say, is this right or is this wrong?
sentences.zh: 还有共和党人，来回答这个问题并说，这是对的还是错的？

sentences.en: If he's going to own up to most of it and assuming that more officials come forward and fill in different pieces of this story as we're coming to understand it, you know,
sentences.zh: 如果他要承认大部分事实，并且假设更多的官员站出来，填补我们所理解的这个故事的不同部分，你知道，

sentences.en: can they stomach that?
sentences.zh: 他们能忍受吗？

sentences.en: And is that a transgression that they're willing to say is worthy of impeachment and worthy of his removal from office?
sentences.zh: 这是否是一种他们愿意称之为值得弹劾并值得将他免职的越界行为？

sentences.en: I mean, it's kind of on the president's part, potentially, you know, the ultimate high stakes bluff.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这在总统方面，可能，你知道，是终极的高风险虚张声势。

sentences.en: And I don't think we know yet where things are going to fall out.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们还不知道事情会如何收场。

sentences.en: I think what we're left with at the end of this week is like a question.
sentences.zh: 我认为本周结束时我们留下的是一个问题。

sentences.en: Is this a story of a bunch of career diplomats who have never really much liked President Trump or his policies rebelling against him?
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于一群从未真正喜欢过特朗普总统或其政策的职业外交官反叛他的故事吗？

sentences.en: And I don't think that they really see it that way.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他们真的那样看。

sentences.en: From their perspective, you know, they're used to having policy differences with presidents of both parties.
sentences.zh: 从他们的角度来看，你知道，他们习惯于与两党的总统存在政策分歧。

sentences.en: They're trained to implement the policies of Republicans and of Democrats.
sentences.zh: 他们受过训练去执行共和党和民主党的政策。

sentences.en: What I think is different, what is, you know, leading otherwise anonymous officials to blow the whistle,
sentences.zh: 我认为不同的是，是什么在，你知道，引导原本匿名的官员吹哨，

sentences.en: to march up to Capitol Hill and walk down all those flights of steps to the House skiff and tell the story as they see it,
sentences.zh: 走上国会山，走下那些通往众议院SCIF的楼梯，并讲述他们所看到的故事，

sentences.en: is that they see this as something fundamentally different and, importantly, as a part of their responsibility as, you know, permanent agents of the government,
sentences.zh: 是因为他们认为这在根本上是不同的，而且重要的是，这是他们作为，你知道，政府常任代理人责任的一部分，

sentences.en: of people who are working on behalf of the American people, not a particular president.
sentences.zh: 是那些代表美国人民工作的人，而不是代表某位特定总统。

sentences.en: And that only when things seem to get so bad did they decide they needed to speak up.
sentences.zh: 只有当事情看起来变得如此糟糕时，他们才决定需要站出来说话。

sentences.en: Nick, thank you for essentially giving us your entire week.
sentences.zh: 尼克，谢谢你基本上把整个星期都给了我们。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: It was a pleasure to have the company.
sentences.zh: 能有你们的陪伴真是太好了。

sentences.en: It can get lonely in front of a skiff, I imagine.
sentences.zh: 我想，在小船前独自一人会感到孤单吧。

sentences.en: Thank you, truly.
sentences.zh: 真心感谢你们。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm glad you guys were here.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我很高兴你们能来。

sentences.en: It's been quite a story.
sentences.zh: 这真是一段非凡的经历。

sentences.en: So on Thursday night, there's a huge bipartisan outcry.
sentences.zh: 周四晚上，两党爆发了巨大的抗议声。

sentences.en: And the White House Chief of Staff, Mick Mulvaney, tries to walk back his comments about a quid pro quo with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 白宫办公厅主任米克·马尔瓦尼试图收回他关于乌克兰“利益交换”的言论。

sentences.en: He issues a statement essentially denying what he has said just a few hours earlier.
sentences.zh: 他发表了一份声明，实质上否认了他几个小时前所说的话。

sentences.en: And I'm going to read you the quote.
sentences.zh: 我来给你们读一下那段引语。

sentences.en: He said, let me be clear.
sentences.zh: 他说，让我说清楚。

sentences.en: There was absolutely no quid pro quo between Ukrainian military aid and any investigation into the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰军事援助与对2016年大选的任何调查之间绝对不存在“利益交换”。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: How does it sound?
sentences.zh: 听起来怎么样？

sentences.en: It sounds pretty good.
sentences.zh: 听起来很不错。

sentences.en: I've never actually produced a bit of any audio on my own.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未亲自制作过音频片段。

sentences.en: So this is extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 所以这太不寻常了。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太棒了。

sentences.en: And I think this is definitely the first time we have done the headlines of the Daily inside the Senate Press Gallery.
sentences.zh: 我想这绝对是我们第一次在参议院新闻发布厅录制《每日新闻》的头条内容。

sentences.en: So it's Cheryl Solberg.
sentences.zh: 这是谢丽尔·索尔伯格。

sentences.en: Oh, I think I'm supposed to hold this to my own mouth.
sentences.zh: 哦，我想我应该把它举到自己嘴边。

sentences.en: So, Cheryl, what do we need to know today?
sentences.zh: 那么，谢丽尔，今天我们需要了解什么？

sentences.en: So it was a really busy news day.
sentences.zh: 今天的新闻非常繁忙。

sentences.en: Today, I'm proud to report,
sentences.zh: 今天，我很自豪地向大家报告，

sentences.en: thanks to the strong leadership of President Donald Trump and the strong relationship between President Erdogan and Turkey and the United States of America,
sentences.zh: 得益于唐纳德·特朗普总统的强力领导，以及埃尔多安总统与土耳其和美利坚合众国之间的稳固关系，

sentences.en: that today the United States and Turkey have agreed to a ceasefire in Syria.
sentences.zh: 今天美国和土耳其已同意在叙利亚停火。

sentences.en: Vice President Pence flew to Turkey and on Thursday afternoon,
sentences.zh: 彭斯副总统飞往土耳其，并在周四下午，

sentences.en: he announced that Turkey had agreed to a ceasefire in which the Turkish government would suspend its military operations in northern Syria for five days in order to give the Kurds time to clear the area.
sentences.zh: 他宣布土耳其已同意停火，土耳其政府将暂停在叙利亚北部的军事行动五天，以便让库尔德人有时间撤离该地区。

sentences.en: So that raises the question, is this a breakthrough or is this just giving Turkey what it wants in the first place because they wanted the Kurds out?
sentences.zh: 这引发了一个问题：这究竟是一个突破，还是仅仅满足了土耳其最初的愿望，因为他们本来就想赶走库尔德人？

sentences.en: What else?
sentences.zh: 还有什么？

sentences.en: Will you support this deal?
sentences.zh: 你会支持这项协议吗？

sentences.en: What do you think of it?
sentences.zh: 你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: From what we've read of this deal, it doesn't meet our demands or expectations.
sentences.zh: 根据我们对这项协议的了解，它没有达到我们的要求或期望。

sentences.en: There's finally a deal for Brexit that the European Union and Britain both think will work.
sentences.zh: 欧盟和英国终于达成了一项双方都认为可行的脱欧协议。

sentences.en: But it's not clear if it's going to pass because it has to go through Parliament and the Labour Party has already said it's opposed.
sentences.zh: 但目前还不清楚它能否通过，因为它必须经过议会批准，而工党已经表示反对。

sentences.en: We are unhappy with this deal and as it stands, we'll vote against it.
sentences.zh: 我们对这项协议不满意，按照目前的情况，我们将投反对票。

sentences.en: And finally on Thursday, it was a sad day here in the Capitol because Representative Elijah Cummings, a towering figure in the House, died.
sentences.zh: 最后，周四对于国会大厦来说是悲伤的一天，因为众议院的泰斗级人物、众议员以利亚·卡明斯去世了。

sentences.en: Cummings was a son of sharecroppers.
sentences.zh: 卡明斯是佃农的儿子。

sentences.en: His own presence here was really a miracle to him.
sentences.zh: 他能出现在这里，对他自己来说确实是一个奇迹。

sentences.en: My father had never been in the Capitol building.
sentences.zh: 我父亲从未进过国会大厦。

sentences.en: He said, isn't this a place where they used to call us slaves?
sentences.zh: 他说，这里难道不是他们过去称我们为奴隶的地方吗？

sentences.en: I said, yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，先生。

sentences.en: Isn't this a place they used to call us three-fifths of a man?
sentences.zh: 这里难道不是他们过去称我们为五分之三个人的地方吗？

sentences.en: I said, yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，先生。

sentences.en: And isn't this a place that they used to call us chattel?
sentences.zh: 这里难道不是他们过去称我们为动产的地方吗？

sentences.en: I said, yes, yes, yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，是的，是的，先生。

sentences.en: And I'll never forget.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: He said, when I think about you being sworn in today, he said, now I see what I could have been if I'd had an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 他说，当我想到你今天宣誓就职时，他说，现在我看到了如果我有机会，我本可以成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: And over the last year as chairman of the House Oversight Committee, he had been a central figure in the investigations of the president.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，作为众议院监督委员会主席，他一直是总统调查的核心人物。

sentences.en: And in his role in these investigations, he continually pleaded for decency.
sentences.zh: 在这些调查中，他不断呼吁要保持体面。

sentences.en: We are better than this.
sentences.zh: 我们本可以做得更好。

sentences.en: We are so much, we really are.
sentences.zh: 我们真的可以做得更好。

sentences.en: As a country, we are so much better than this.
sentences.zh: 作为一个国家，我们完全可以做得更好。

sentences.en: And I'm hoping that all of us can get back to this democracy that we want and that we should be passing on our children so that they can do better than what we did.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们所有人都能回归我们所向往的民主，并将其传承给我们的孩子，让他们比我们做得更好。

sentences.en: Cheryl, thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We're walking out.
sentences.zh: 我们正在走出去。
